statement: The CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog records 3 or more entries with dateAdded between 2026-09-01 and 2026-09-14.
resolution: Resolves true if the published CISA KEV catalog feed shows 3 or more entries with dateAdded in the window when checked at the deadline; false if it shows fewer than 3.
failure_condition: The CISA KEV catalog shows fewer than 3 entries with a dateAdded value between 2026-09-01 and 2026-09-14 when checked against the published feed.

statement: The Federal Open Market Committee raises the federal funds target range at its September 15-16, 2026 meeting.
resolution: Resolves true if the FOMC statement released 2026-09-16 sets the federal funds target range above the range in effect the day before the meeting; false if held or cut.
failure_condition: The FOMC holds or lowers the federal funds target range at its September 15-16, 2026 meeting rather than raising it.
